patthana21.13:1.1: na sārammaṇaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā sārammaṇo kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā ekaṃ.
patthana21.13:2.1: na sārammaṇaṃ na akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā sārammaṇo akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā ekaṃ.
patthana21.13:3.1: na anārammaṇaṃ na abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anārammaṇo abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā ekaṃ. nacittaduka nakusalattike cittaduka kusalattikaṃ na
patthana21.13:4.1: cittaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā citto kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana21.13:5.1: hetuyā tīṇi. na akusale tīṇi. na abyākate tīṇi. saṅkhittaṃ.
patthana21.13:6.1: nacetasikaduka nakusalattike cetasikaduka kusalattikaṃ na cetasikaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā cetasiko kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana21.13:7.1: hetuyā tīṇi. nacittasampayuttaduka nakusalattike cittasampayuttaduka kusalattikaṃ
patthana21.13:8.1: na cittasampayuttaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā cittasampayutto kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana21.13:9.1: hetuyā tīṇi. nacittasaṃsaṭṭhaduka nakusalattike cittasaṃsaṭṭhaduka kusalattikaṃ
patthana21.13:10.1: na cittasaṃsaṭṭhaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā cittasaṃsaṭṭho kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana21.13:11.1: hetuyā tīṇi. nacittasamuṭṭhānaduka nakusalattike cittasamuṭṭhānaduka kusalattikaṃ
patthana21.13:12.1: na cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā cittasamuṭṭhāno kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana21.13:13.1: hetuyā tīṇi. nacittasahabhuduka nakusalattike cittasahabhuduka kusalattikaṃ
patthana21.13:14.1: na cittasahabhuṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā cittasahabhū kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana21.13:15.1: hetuyā tīṇi. nacittānuparivattiduka nakusalattike cittānuparivattiduka kusalattikaṃ
patthana21.13:16.1: na cittānuparivattiṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā cittānuparivattī kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana21.13:18.1: na cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāno kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana21.13:19.1: hetuyā tīṇi. nacittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānasahabhuduka nakusalattike cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānasahabhuduka kusalattikaṃ
patthana21.13:20.1: na cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānasahabhuṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānasahabhū kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana21.13:21.1: hetuyā tīṇi. nacittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānānuparivattiduka nakusalattike cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānānuparivattiduka kusalattikaṃ
patthana21.13:22.1: na cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānānuparivattiṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānānuparivattī kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana21.13:23.1: hetuyā tīṇi. naajjhattikaduka nakusalattike ajjhattikaduka kusalattikaṃ
patthana21.13:24.1: na ajjhattikaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā ajjhattiko kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana21.13:25.1: hetuyā tīṇi. naupādāduka nakusalattike upādāduka kusalattikaṃ
patthana21.13:26.1: na noupādā na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā noupādā kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana21.13:28.1: na anupādinnaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā anupādinno kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
